description: Free inspection of unsigned x402 terms. Default analysis version 1 retains Exact EVM checks; analysis_version 2 inspects documented EVM Exact, Upto, Batch Settlement and Auth-Capture profiles, declared limits and lifecycle fields. Unknown fields stay unchecked. No wallet, signature verification, live contract validation or settlement.

analysis_version.description: 1 preserves the original Exact EVM report. 2 selects documented multi-scheme structural inspection, report version 2.0.0.

challenge.description: Decoded PaymentRequired object from HTTP or MCP structuredContent. No signed payment or credentials.

expected.description: Optional exact terms. An atomic budget requires network and asset.
